prose.name: Bounty: Stock Thief on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A stockwoman at the <Place> is losing animals at night, two a week, to raiders who carry them up to their boss. She has asked for someone to come and see her.

beats.objective: Talk to the stockwoman at the <Place>
beats.journal: A stockwoman at the <Place> is losing two animals a week to raiders, who carry them to their boss at the <SecondPlace>. She asked me to deal with him.

person.name: Maura Ketley
person._outfit: 11a's farmer outfit, already worn in game. His eye decides.
hellos: You'll be the one who answered the call.

greeting: They come at night and take two at a time.
They carry them up to their boss. He's the one eating them.

reply: Take him, and the carrying stops.

She had another eight years in her.

exchanges.prompt: Is there a price on him?
reply: If there is, you're welcome to it. I only want my stock left alone.
